one_liner: A dashboard that turns a small business's scattered spreadsheets into one daily view.

classification.strategy: Replace the Monday-morning spreadsheet scramble with a two-minute glance.

subject: a 28-year-old East Asian woman, genuinely pretty in a real everyday way, fair-to-medium skin with natural visible texture and a few small pores, faint redness around the nose, soft under-eye shadows, little to no makeup, dark hair worn down with a slight natural wave and a few loose flyaway strands, warm easy presence
setting: at a tidy home desk in a softly lit room during the day; a large window is off to her left casting soft directional daylight onto the left side of her face while the right side falls into gentle natural shadow; an open laptop, a coffee mug, and a leafy plant softly out of focus behind her
expression: talking warmly and casually to her phone like she is recommending something to a friend, relaxed genuine half-smile

persona.eye_direction: looking straight into the lens, with a small natural glance toward her laptop on the product line

beats.dialogue: Okay, I have to show you this.
beats.action: a relaxed half-smile, leaning a little toward the camera

beats.dialogue: I used to drown in spreadsheets every single Monday.
beats.action: a small tired half-eye-roll, glancing off toward her laptop

beats.dialogue: Then we got Lumen, and now I check the whole business in like two minutes.
beats.action: tipping her head toward the open laptop beside her

beats.dialogue: Honestly, it's right here on my phone — just try it.
beats.action: a small easy shrug and a warm genuine smile
